tweets.text:
Money networks make the same choice. Each keeps a shared record called a ledger and must pick who adds the next page.

Bitcoin picks by work. Miners run computers and pay for power, a cost paid outside the network. Staking networks pick by coins you lock up, a cost paid inside.
